latest_release.name: v0.4.1
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

### Highlights:

- Added SARIF and DefectDojo-compatible JSON output ([#1085](https://github.com/OWASP/Nettacker/pull/1085)).
- Added custom wordlists and directory-enumeration base paths ([#1026](https://github.com/OWASP/Nettacker/pull/1026), [#1019](https://github.com/OWASP/Nettacker/pull/1019)).
- Added port exclusions, HTTP scheme selection, custom request headers, and sensitive-header filtering ([#1099](https://github.com/OWASP/Nettacker/pull/1099), [#1342](https://github.com/OWASP/Nettacker/pull/1342), [#1107](https://github.com/OWASP/Nettacker/pull/1107)).
- Exposed service-discovery, port-exclusion, and custom-header options in the Web UI ([#1113](https://github.com/OWASP/Nettacker/pull/1113)).
- Added browser uploads for targets and wordlists ([#1552](https://github.com/OWASP/Nettacker/pull/1552)).
- Added searchable profiles, scan methods, and results to the Web UI ([#1675](https://github.com/OWASP/Nettacker/pull/1675)).
- Added crt.name support to subdomain discovery ([#1661](https://github.com/OWASP/Nettacker/pull/1661)).
- Moved runtime data from .data to .nettacker/data, including automatic SQLite database migration ([#1100](https://github.com/OWASP/Nettacker/pull/1100)).
- Added FreeBSD support and ARM container images ([#1136](https://github.com/OWASP/Nettacker/pull/1136), [#1351](https://github.com/OWASP/Nettacker/pull/1351)).
- Removed the NumPy dependency ([#947](https://github.com/OWASP/Nettacker/pull/947)).

### New scanning coverage

- Added CUPS, configuration-file, SMB brute-force, Jenkins, SmarterMail, CrushFTP patch-date, and Adobe AEM patch-date scanners.
- Expanded WordPress plugin coverage and refreshed bundled discovery wordlists.
- Added detection for:
  - Palo Alto PAN-OS CVE-2025-0108 and GlobalProtect CVE-2025-0133
  - SonicWall SSLVPN CVE-2024-53704
  - WordPress CVE-2023-47668 and CVE-2026-63030
  - Joomla CVE-2023-23752
  - aiohttp CVE-2024-23334
  - Vite CVE-2025-31125
  - CrushFTP CVE-2025-31161
  - Meteobridge CVE-2025-4008
  - SmarterMail CVE-2026-24423
  - React2Shell CVE-2025-55182
  - Memos CVE-2025-22952
  - GeoServer CVE-2024-36401
  - Langflow CVE-2025-3248
  - SiYuan CVE-2026-34605
  - Sonatype Nexus Repository CVE-2024-4956
  - Majordomo CVE-2026-27174
  - Adobe ColdFusion CVE-2026-48282
  - Nginx UI CVE-2026-33032
  - Metabase CVE-2026-72898
